paragraphs: The XE D240 was a high-output diesel variant in the X760-generation XE range, using the Ingenium AJ200D 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine. It was produced from around 2015 until the diesel engine was dropped from the UK and North American markets around 2020. As a discontinued model, we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace engine engines for every XE D240 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder diesel fitted to the XE D240. Known for timing chain and injector seal wear over time — see the callout above. We replace both as standard on every AJ200D rebuild, along with EGR components and gaskets where necessary.

compatibility.intro: The XE D240 uses a single engine family — the Ingenium AJ200D — across its entire production run. However, we still confirm your exact vehicle specification via registration before any work begins to ensure the correct parts and procedures are used for your specific model year and configuration.
